title: Target Level Readiness Check
line: 7 questions, one for each pillar. About two minutes.
honest: A self-check. Your answers stay on this device and nobody else sees them. It is not an assessment of your component, and it is not a report to the portfolio office.

items.question: Are the 13 Target Level activities of the User pillar done, or dated and resourced to finish by 30 September 2027?
items.next: Open the User pillar, list its Target Level activities that are not done, and put an owner and a date on each.
